releaseNotes: AURA 3.8.0 is the stability and accuracy release: MIDI output is now strictly manual (arm + Send MIDI Now - analysis modes never move your faders), AURA Link routes with plugin windows closed and recovers automatically, spectra average true power (honest band advice on sparse content), all meters are sample-rate-consistent, Full Track reports count audio time instead of wall-clock, and advice only fires on fresh non-silent audio. Also new since 3.6: the STEM FIELD per-stem spectrum view (triple-click the Mix Score dial) and optional local AI via Ollama in Settings.
